# 📚 English Review — Week 10: Literary Elements & Grammar!

Excellent term, Grade 4! This week we review the key skills from Term 1. 💪

## 🎭 Literary Elements
- **Character**: the people or animals in the story; the **protagonist** is the main character
- **Setting**: *where* and *when* the story takes place
- **Plot**: the sequence of events — **exposition** → **rising action** → **climax** → **falling action** → **resolution**
- **Theme**: the central message or lesson of the story
- **Conflict**: the main problem the character faces

## 🔍 Reading Strategies
- **Context clues**: use surrounding words to figure out the meaning of an unfamiliar word
- **Main idea**: the most important point of a paragraph; **supporting details** back it up
- **Sequence**: signal words like *first, next, then, finally* show order of events
- **Cause and effect**: what happens (effect) and why it happens (cause)

## ✏️ Grammar Review
- **Nouns**: common, proper, abstract (*happiness, freedom*), collective (*a team of players*)
- **Verbs**: action (*run*), linking (*is, seems*), helping (*has, will*)
- **Adjectives**: descriptive, comparative (*bigger*), superlative (*biggest*)
- **Subject-verb agreement**: *The students **are** smart.* / *The student **is** smart.*

You have grown so much as a reader and writer! ⭐

Mathematics.summary_markdown:
# 🔢 Mathematics Review — Week 10: Numbers to Millions & Operations!

Let's review the big ideas from Term 1 Math! 🏆

## 🔢 Numbers to Millions
- **Place value** of a 7-digit number: Millions | Hundred-Thousands | Ten-Thousands | Thousands | Hundreds | Tens | Ones
- **Reading**: 1,234,567 → "one million, two hundred thirty-four thousand, five hundred sixty-seven"
- **Rounding**: look at the digit to the RIGHT of the place you're rounding to
  - 3,456 rounded to the nearest thousand → **3,000** (4 < 5, so round down)
  - 3,678 rounded to the nearest thousand → **4,000** (6 ≥ 5, so round up)

## ➕➖ Addition & Subtraction
- Always align place values before adding or subtracting
- Regroup (carry/borrow) when needed

## ✖️÷ Multiplication & Division
- Multiplication: **2 to 4-digit numbers × 2-digit numbers**
  - Use partial products or long multiplication
- Division: **Estimate the quotient**, then **divide, multiply, subtract, bring down**

## 💡 Problem Solving
1. Understand → 2. Plan → 3. Solve → 4. Check
- For multi-step problems: solve one step at a time!

You're a mathematical thinker! 🌟

# 🇵🇭 Filipino — Linggo 10 Pagsasanay: Gramatika at Panitikan!

Sinasalamin ng wikang Filipino ang ating kultura at pagpapahalaga. Balikan natin ang ating mga natutunan! 💪

## 📖 Uri ng Pangungusap (Review)
- **Pasalaysay** → tuldok (.)
- **Patanong** → tandang pananong (?)
- **Pautos** → tandang padamdam (!) o tuldok (.)
- **Padamdam** → tandang padamdam (!)

## 🔤 Mga Bahagi ng Pangungusap
- **Simuno**: paksa ng pangungusap
- **Panaguri**: nagsasabi tungkol sa simuno
- **Komplimentong Tuwirang Layon** (KTL): tinatanggap ang kilos ng pandiwa
  - Halimbawa: Kumain si Juan ng *mangga.* → "mangga" = KTL

## 🌟 Talasalitaan
- **Salitang-ugat**: pangunahing salita bago magkaroon ng panlapi
  - Halimbawa: *laro* → naglalaro, naglaro, maglalaro
- **Panlapi**: prefix (*mag-*, *na-*, *i-*) at suffix (*-in*, *-an*, *-an*)
  - Halimbawa: *luto* + *-in* = *lutuin* | *mag-* + *luto* = *magluto*

## 📚 Akdang Pampanitikan
- **Maikling Kwento**: nagtatampok ng iisang pangyayari, maliit na bilang ng tauhan, may resolusyon
- **Tula**: may ritmo, tunog, at imahe; gumagamit ng talinghaga

Napakahusay mong mag-aaral ng Filipino! 🌟

# 🔬 Science Review — Week 10: Matter and Its Properties!

Great work, scientists! Let's review everything we've learned about **matter**. 🌟

## 🧊💧💨 States of Matter
- **Solid**: definite shape and volume; particles packed closely → *ice, rock, wood*
- **Liquid**: definite volume but takes the shape of its container → *water, juice, oil*
- **Gas**: no definite shape or volume; expands to fill container → *air, steam, oxygen*

## ⚗️ Properties of Matter
- **Physical properties**: color, odor, texture, hardness, solubility, conductivity, mass, volume
- **Density**: how much mass in a given volume; determines if an object floats or sinks
  - Object **denser than water** → sinks | Object **less dense than water** → floats

## 🥄 Mixtures
- **Mixture**: two or more substances combined; each keeps its own properties
- **Homogeneous (solution)**: evenly mixed → *salt water, vinegar*
- **Heterogeneous**: not evenly mixed; parts visible → *salad, sand and gravel*
- **Separating mixtures**: filtering, decanting, evaporation, using a magnet

## 🔄 Physical vs. Chemical Changes
- **Physical change**: form changes, substance stays the same → *cutting, melting, dissolving*
- **Chemical change**: a new substance is formed → *burning, rusting, baking*

Matter matters! 🌍

# 🌏 Araling Panlipunan — Linggo 10 Pagsasanay: Pilipinas sa Asya!

Balikan natin ang ating mga natutunan tungkol sa Pilipinas at Asya! 🌟

## 🗺️ Heograpiya ng Pilipinas
- Ang Pilipinas ay nasa **Timog-Silangang Asya**
- May **7,641 na pulo**; nahahati sa Luzon, Visayas, at Mindanao
- **Hangganan**: Karagatang Pasipiko (silangan), Dagat Tsina sa Timog (kanluran)
- **Klima**: tropical — mainit at mahalumigmig; may **tag-ulan** at **tag-araw**
- Epekto ng lokasyon: maraming **bagyo**, malaking karagatan → **pangingisda**

## 🌿 Likas na Yaman
- **Kagubatan**: narra, lawaan, molave (kahoy); pinagmumulan ng hangin
- **Mineral**: ginto, pilak, bakal, tanso, kromo
- **Karagatan**: pagkain (isda, alimasag, hipon), industriya
- **Agrikultura**: palay, mais, niyog, saging, kamote

## 🤝 Kultura at Pagkakakilanlan
- Higit sa **175 grupong etniko** — bawat isa ay may sariling wika, sining, at kaugalian
- **Pagkain**: adobo, sinigang, lechon — nagpapakita ng impluwensiya ng kasaysayan
- **Pamilya** ang sentro ng kulturang Pilipino
- **Bayanihan** — tradisyon ng pagtutulungan ng komunidad

Ipagmahal ang ating mayamang kultura at kalikasan! 🇵🇭

- **Hardware**: physical parts — monitor, keyboard, mouse, CPU, printer

- The **Internet** is a global network of connected computers
- A **browser** (e.g., Chrome) helps you navigate websites
- A **search engine** (e.g., Google) finds information
- **Internet Safety Rules**:
  - Never share personal information online (full name, address, phone)
  - Ask a trusted adult before clicking unknown links
  - Be kind online — cyberbullying is wrong

- Respect others online | Think before you post | Protect your privacy

Stay smart and safe online! 🔐

# 🎵🏃 MAPEH — Week 10 Review: Music & Physical Education!

Let's review the exciting things we've learned in **Music** and **PE** this term! 🌟

## 🎵 Elements of Music
- **Melody**: a sequence of musical notes that forms the tune of a song
- **Rhythm**: the pattern of beats in music — some long, some short
- **Tempo**: the speed of the music → *allegro* (fast) | *andante* (slow)
- **Dynamics**: the loudness or softness → *forte* (loud) | *piano* (soft)
- **Pitch**: how high or low a note sounds
- **Timbre**: the unique quality of a sound that identifies an instrument

## 🎶 Philippine Folk Songs
- Traditional songs reflect Filipino culture and values
- Example: *Bahay Kubo* (about plants grown around the home)

## 🏃 Physical Education: Components of Fitness
- **Cardiovascular endurance**: ability of heart/lungs to sustain exercise → *running, swimming*
- **Muscular strength**: maximum force a muscle can exert → *push-ups, lifting*
- **Muscular endurance**: ability to repeat a movement → *sit-ups*
- **Flexibility**: range of motion in joints → *stretching*
- **Body composition**: ratio of fat to lean muscle mass

## 🌿 Health & Wellness
- Regular exercise + balanced diet + enough sleep = healthy body and mind!

Keep moving and keep making music! 🎵🏆

Napakahusay mong mag-aaral! Balikan natin ang ating mga aral sa pagpapahalaga. 🌟

## 🌟 Pagpapahalaga (Values) Review
- **Katapatan (Honesty)**: palaging nagsasabi ng totoo kahit mahirap
- **Paggalang (Respect)**: pagturing sa iba nang may dignidad at pagpapahalaga
- **Responsibilidad**: pagtanggap at pagsasagawa ng ating mga tungkulin

- Ang pamilya ang **pinakamahalagang grupo** sa buhay ng isang tao

- Ang bawat miyembro ay may papel sa komunidad

- Halimbawa: paglalinis ng kapaligiran, pagsali sa mga gawaing pangkomunidad
